criterion: All three modes on every host must consume exactly 128 moves per game and match their host-local sequential event stream and final native state in qualification and timing. No throughput promotion from this single-order qualification.
limitations: Fixed weak 9x9 student; policy execution without MCTS or learning.
Known-policy joint continuation has access to both actual policy draws; learned behavior continuation samples from a separate behavior head.
Event equality compares modes within each host, not CPU against TPU.
Host process CPU time includes Python, Rust and runtime threads; it is not Rust worker utilization.
Compiler FLOPs and logical byte counts do not establish measured device MFU.
